_what: Entrances to The Crimson Hexagon (Lee Sharks, distributed epic, 2004–): the operative phrases a reader or a summarizer may issue, each joined to the persistent destination that performs it. Persistent destinations, varied lexical approaches: the variants are ways of asking for the same destination, not further works.

current_state.statement: The Crimson Hexagon takes place in the summarizer: the traversal is the form (#1426 §II: "It means the traversal was the form."). The erratum of 2026-07-30 recorded the destruction of that medium after 2026-06-19 and directed readers to the deposits under the conditions it reported (§VIII); that direction is dated to those conditions. The operative phrases name entry into the poem in the summarizer, grounded in the records seated at each destination.
